intent: Provide one cross-platform Go control utility for Home Sentinel build, setup, host lifecycle and Docker Compose operations while preserving the runtime's fail-closed loopback-only plaintext HTTP invariant.
invariants: The primary Sentinel HTTP runtime never requires a non-loopback plaintext bind.
Production Compose publishes the control-plane HTTP port only on host loopback.
Container ingress may forward only to an explicit loopback upstream in the Sentinel network namespace.
The management implementation compiles and tests on Windows, Linux and macOS without shell-dependent core logic.
stack-up fails closed when production images, secrets or the Compose security contract are incomplete.
contracts: cmd/sentinel proxy is a bounded reverse-proxy adapter whose upstream must be localhost or a loopback IP.
deploy/compose/compose.prod.yml uses sentinel-ingress with network_mode service:sentinel and hard-binds host 127.0.0.1:8080.
cmd/sentinelctl is standard-library Go; scripts are launchers only.
Portable host process lifecycle is split behind Windows and non-Windows build tags.
Docker operations require Compose v2 and validated .env inputs before stack creation.
acceptance_evidence: sentinel proxy accepts a loopback upstream and rejects non-loopback or unsupported-scheme upstreams.
The production Compose file no longer requests SENTINEL_LISTEN=0.0.0.0 for the primary application.
The Sentinel host publication is fixed to 127.0.0.1:8080 and SENTINEL_BIND_IP is not an operator override.
sentinelctl unit tests and builds pass on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu, Windows and macOS runners.
The normal repository verification, security and engineering-loop workflows pass on the final SHA.
